Quick guide

01 · Edit the lesson

Edit planner fields and activity durations. Use Move up / Move down to reorder and mark activities Completed. A warning appears when the total exceeds the planned duration.

02 · Update competencies

Choose statuses in the table. Filter by group, search names or select a competency to identify students needing support. Click a name for detailed feedback.

03 · Enter rubric ratings

In the student panel, choose a rating from 1–4 for each criterion. The final score is available only when all five criteria are rated and weights total 100%.

04 · Export & print

Export CSV downloads student records and ratings from the current view. Print the lesson plan or progress report on paper or save as PDF. Export before switching devices or resetting the demo.

Demo Data · All names and records are fictional. Changes are saved automatically in this browser and on this device only; data is not synced between devices. Clearing browser data removes your edits.

Reset Demo Data?

All lesson edits, competencies, ratings and notes in this browser will be replaced with the original demo data. Export CSV first if you need a copy.
